$comment: Canonical Cork deployment addresses/config. Runtime behavior: the tool fetches the latest copy of THIS file from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, main branch) with TTL caching; this committed copy ships with the distribution as the fallback when the fetch fails. Addresses are CREATE2-verifiable where an attestation exists (cork_capabilities topic:'verify'). Partial chains omit unknown contracts deliberately — handlers gate per capability.
$v13Comment: 42161 + 8453 defaults are phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 (github.com/Cork-Technology/phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1, prerelease 2026-08-07): identical CREATE2 addresses on both chains via the Safe Singleton Factory; runtime hashes chain-verified, pool-manager impl slot + adapter CORK()/BUNDLER3() bindings re-verified on-chain 2026-08-07. bundler3 per chain comes from the deployed CorkAdapter's own BUNDLER3() immutable (Morpho infra, not in the release table). Adopted together with market-registry 0.3.2 (Zian's redeploy against this pool manager) — the generations are ALIGNED. The previous Arbitrum production stack (the venue's existing markets live there until the venue migrates) is preserved as deploymentProfiles['42161']['arbitrum-v1.1']; rollover still binds the v1.1 stack (its redeploy is pending).
$fusionComment: 1inch Fusion settlement reference set (third-party, classification only — the ACTIVE settlement is always decoded from the order's own extension bytes). current = the v3.1 layout this tool prices (fusion-protocol deployments@master, CREATE3, code verified on-chain 2026-07-28: mainnet=Settlement, arbitrum=SimpleSettlement; base verified 2026-08-07: runtime byte-identical to Arbitrum's SimpleSettlement except ONE 20-byte immutable, the chain's WETH — 0x4200…0006 vs 0x82aF…Bab1); legacy = recognized-but-refused older layouts (v2 present on all three chains; v1 is mainnet-only and LOP v3 era).
$marketRegistryComment: MarketRegistry stack, contracts release 0.3.2 (Zian's full redeploy 2026-08-07 against the v1.3.0-rc.1 pool manager; identical addresses on 42161 + 8453 via ONE AtomicDeployer batch — guarded CREATE2, salts attested in packages/core/src/config.ts; adapter bindings + isRecipe for all three recipes verified on-chain on BOTH chains 2026-08-07). `recipes` are NAMED HINTS for the deprecated mode sugar only — membership is decided solely by isRecipe on chain. The 0.3.2 controller splits fee authority into FEE_MANAGER_ROLE (the adapter needs POOL_CREATOR + FEE_MANAGER; grant pending a Safe signature as of 2026-08-07 — prepares warn roles_not_granted until it lands). The 0.3.0 predecessor (registry 0x47C3AF38435Db64D9400c30575E4c10482c0752D, v1.1-pool-manager-bound) is superseded and dropped from config — git history has its full record. The PRE-2.1.0 generation (different interface, misdecoding answers) stays under marketRegistryLegacy, reachable only with CORK_ENABLE_DEPRECATED=1.
